notes: Recorded by W1 follow-up 1 (task_label W1-followup-1); the task field is left out because run@1 accepts only W<n>-S<nn> or W<n>-T<nn> there.
<sandbox>/work in argv stands for a scratch copy of the files listed in inputs, mounted read-only.

Version printed by `lean --version` in the image before the runs: Lean (version 4.35.0, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, commit eb6cafb7290e8bd5f2937522d8d804f58f02bafc, Release); binary_sha256 is sha256sum of the file elan resolves lean to in the same image.

The idle file elaborates past the failed transfer_moves: its one error is that theorem's unsolved goal, the anonymous `example ... ≠ ... := by decide` at (1, 0) with amount 1 raises no error (it is accepted), and `#eval transfer ⟨1, 0⟩ 1` prints the unchanged state. The warning about the unused hypothesis h is the idle transfer_rejected, whose proof never needs it.

Not recorded here: the `--paranoid` (comparator) check of the four theorems that curriculum/S02-proof.md lists for this run. It needs the LAB-2 challenge project and comparator, which this run did not use; the lesson cells cite only the Lean verdicts recorded here.
argv holds one command line per configuration, in configs order; exit_code and verdict_lines at the top level are the primary configuration's.
